fixes_applied.issue: Swatch selector [role='radio'] was too broad — matched both color AND size radio buttons. First PLP product (25688608M) has 1 color swatch and 5 size swatches, so nth(1) clicked a size swatch which doesn't change gallery image.
fixes_applied.fix: Scoped selector to color radiogroup only: `modal.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: /color/i }).locator('[role="radio"]')`. Added safety skip when no color radiogroup is found.

fixes_applied.issue: BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS was missing pattern for 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 403 (Forbidden)'. The existing /r: 403 Forbidden/ regex doesn't match Chrome's resource-loading error format. These are pre-existing Einstein recommendation 403s (baseline.json count: 4).
fixes_applied.fix: Added `/Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 403 \(Forbidden\)/` to BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS array.

fixes_applied.issue: Variation selection in add-to-bag flow used broad [role='radio'] selector that mixed color and size swatches.
fixes_applied.fix: Updated variation selection logic to use scoped radiogroup selectors: `modal.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: /size/i })` and `modal.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: /color/i })` separately, with explicit wait for button to become enabled.
